blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–National University leaned on Tebol Garcia and Reinhard Jumamoy for a fourth-quarter surge to beat University of the East, 91-74, and secure a Final Four berth in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Garcia and Jumamoy combined for 15 points in a decisive 16-0 run that turned the Bulldogs’ slim 73-70 lead into an 89-70 advantage with 1:51 remaining. NU improved to 9-2 for its third straight win and a second consecutive Final Four appearance, joining University of the Philippines in securing a playoff […]...
